capabilities: Open a set of random notes ranked by a local LLM
Run a Haystack retrieval pipeline in a terminal alongside Obsidian
Configure how many ranked pages open at once
Replace the retrieval model by editing rr_app.py
disambiguation: Not a search tool; the LLM only ranks a few random notes to open, it does not replace normal vault search.
extras: macOS only for now, with Windows and mobile listed as future plans. Users must set up a conda environment with pip requirements and keep the terminal open while using the plugin. Developers can swap rr_app.py for their own models.
intentEvidence: Random Note, as a core plugin, provides a complete random way to dig it out...
motivation: The author built it because of a bad memory and the pleasure of a treasure hunt, wanting something between Search and Random Note.
problem: Obsidian's Random Note is completely random and Search needs known terms, so unrelated-but-related notes hiding in the vault are hard to stumble upon.

relations.evidence: Retrieval for Retrieval Component in Haystack

requires.name: conda environment with local LLM (terminal must stay open)

summary: Random note opener that uses a local LLM as retriever and ranker, functioning like a mix of fuzzy search and Random Note.
